leads.company: Ambito (ambito.io) — Founding AI Engineer / Equity Partner — Remote
leads.title: See posting
leads.posting: Ambito (ambito.io) — Founding AI Engineer / Equity Partner — Remote Ambito is a CRM-connected QBR generator for B2B sales teams. The product is live, with the sales module, template engine, and CRM integrations already built. We're looking for a founding AI engineer to make the product significantly smarter and broader. This is an equity-only role initially (10+ hrs/week), working directly with the founders and our existing technical partner. You'll work on: AI product features: Build a native assistant that can answer questions about customer data, surface trends, provide setup guidance, and help generate QBRs. Retrieval, tool use, structured-data queries, evals, and cost control. Customer Success: Extend the existing framework into account reviews, renewals, and customer health. Integrations: Harden and expand CRM/CS integrations (Salesforce, HubSpot, etc.). Product: Make the overall experience faster, simpler, and more AI-native where it actually helps. We're looking for someone who has shipped LLM features in production, not just demos, and is comfortable with retrieval, embeddings, tool calling, agent workflows, and evaluation. You should also be able to work across React, TypeScript, and Node (Firebase experience is a plus). You should think like a product engineer: turn varied customer requests into simple, flexible systems and work independently. Sales tech / RevOps / CS experience is a plus. Boston/MA is a plus. To apply: Send a short note with something you've built using AI and why this problem interests you. No cover letter. LinkedIn or contact@ambito.io.

leads.posting: Rebar | Software Engineers (Product, Applied AI, ML Infra, Data Platform) | ONSITE 5 days/week, New York City (union square area!) | Full-time | $150k–$260k + equity | https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/rebar We build AI estimating software for commercial HVAC, plumbing, and electrical contractors. Before bidding on a job, a contractor or estimator has to count every duct, fitting, diffuser, and piece of equipment across a set of construction drawings that can run to thousands of pages. We speed this up by ingesting the drawings, detecting the equipment schedules, finding symbols, and producing a priced takeoff that the estimator reviews and corrects in a collaborative canvas editor. We have strong PMF and raised a $14M Series A earlier this year. It may not sound sexy, but it actually is!! There are a ton of hard and interesting engineering challenges. Just to highlight a few: * very dense document drawings with a realtime collaborative canvas editor (think 50k DOM elements and up) * segmentation models (and many more) whose output has to become geometry a user can interact with * gpu inference across hundreds of concurrent jobs * dynamic analytics and chart generation from agentic workflows custom built for estimators Open roles: * Software Engineer, Product ($180k–$240k): https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/rebar/5ab49c2d-9a70-4723-9217-7704a... * Software Engineer, Applied AI ($150k–$250k): https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/rebar/ad41a627-d9a4-49a4-a1b4-f7202... * Software Engineer, ML Infrastructure ($200k–$260k): https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/rebar/ead8df0c-b6da-4e79-90d0-99651... * Software Engineer, Data Platform ($170k–$220k): https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/rebar/c227ea05-98f8-4a08-9760-f7e3c...
